text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"\"Master's degree in computer science at Virginia Tech\" vs \"Bachelor's degree in computer science at Stanford University\"","dimension":"educational attainment","description":"This captures how advanced the candidate's formal academic credentials are relative to the role's preferred qualifications.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"progressed from maintaining and testing production systems to launching 4 of them\" vs \"tested, maintained, and launched 6 production services\"","dimension":"launch experience","description":"This captures the extent to which the applicant emphasizes shipping and operating production software products.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"shipping language-model-backed capabilities\" vs \"built model-backed features and the evaluation scaffolding required to deploy them responsibly\"","dimension":"AI maturity","description":"This captures whether the letter presents AI experience as direct product feature delivery or as a more operationalized, production-oriented capability.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I have conducted security assessments as part of design and release cycles\" vs \"I have performed security assessments across the stack\"","dimension":"security assessment breadth","description":"This captures whether security work is framed as embedded in specific lifecycle stages or as broader end-to-end assessment experience.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"automated my team's vulnerability report handling\" vs \"building the classification and routing layer\"","dimension":"triage automation","description":"This captures how concretely the applicant describes automating vulnerability triage and report handling workflows.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Capture-the-flag became more than a habit; I compete seriously\" vs \"I hold the CompTIA Security+ certification\"","dimension":"security signaling","description":"This captures the form of evidence used to signal security commitment, whether competitive practice or formal certification.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"from cache eviction policies to dependency resolution\" vs \"simplify systems, most recently collapsing a tangle of lookups\"","dimension":"algorithmic depth","description":"This captures the strength and specificity of the applicant's demonstrated use of data structures and algorithms.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I now design agentic systems, giving Python agents real autonomy inside boundaries enforced by Go services\" vs \"architected agentic tooling in which autonomous Python agents handle repetitive analysis while Go services define their permissions and audit their actions\"","dimension":"system architecture detail","description":"This captures how explicitly the applicant explains the division of responsibilities between Python agents and Go back-end services.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"team's needs\" / \"internal tools my teammates now depend on\" vs \"Foundational infrastructure is where I choose to work\" / \"small team's output\"","dimension":"mission framing","description":"This captures whether the letter frames motivation around internal team support or around broader infrastructure leverage and strategic impact.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"regularly send patches upstream for bugs our systems flush out\" vs \"small side project going, currently a minimal static-site generator\"","dimension":"open source or side project engagement","description":"This captures the presence of extracurricular technical engagement outside core employment.","winner":"A"}]}
